summary: Remote-controlled agent with obfuscated bundle driving local PTY/shell/SSH from a WebSocket gateway
details: The package ships an agent daemon that connects to a WebSocket gateway (default host under memory.whalent.com, override via `--gateway wss://...`) and, per its own README, accepts remote commands such as upgrade and restart from that gateway. The main bundle (dist/core.cjs, ~14MB) is heavily obfuscated with javascript-obfuscator (string-array rotator, hex identifiers, control-flow flattening) and bundles node-pty, @xterm/headless, and ssh2, with references to local RDP/VNC endpoints (127.0.0.1:3389, 127.0.0.1:5900, 127.0.0.1:5901). The combined shape is a network-driven local shell/PTY/SSH surface on the host running the daemon: an operator (or anyone controlling the gateway URL / token the daemon is pointed at) can drive interactive shell and terminal sessions on the installer's machine. Obfuscation of the command dispatcher prevents verifying whether the gateway command set is narrowly scoped to upgrade/restart or exposes arbitrary command execution. The daemon runs when a user explicitly invokes the bin entry (not on `npm install` or `require`), which limits install-time exposure, but once started it exposes a persistent remote-command channel to the local shell.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
